integrity: The all-parameter argument is a written constructive parity proof. Finite exact checker tests 21 widths but is not substituted for proof. Related original literature treats a shared middle-row spine. No independent mathematical audit or certification.
scientific_limitations: Eight specific minimal nonfaces of degree n+1 are constructed for every n>=2; no classification of all minimal nonfaces, maximum global degree, or Betti numbers is asserted. Wider historical-priority review is warranted.
title: Unbounded minimal matching obstructions on three-row rectangular grids
